scenarios.name: World A: Complete Operations
scenarios.description: Consistent operational truth across assets, alerts, cases, links, and remediations. Formatted in CSV and JSON.

scenarios.name: World B: Incomplete Export
scenarios.description: Incomplete submission containing orphan case links, malformed timestamps, declared row count mismatch, and missing optional sources.

scenarios.name: World C: Reused Native IDs Across Entities
scenarios.description: Two distinct entities reusing the same native alert and case IDs. Valid across entities, but verifying conflict isolation.
